findings.problem: With no hint, "crowd" just as often gets die Menschenmenge (or die Masse, das Gedränge), so die Menge isn't the only answer the learner could give.
findings.fix: hint: a crowd of people; the short word, not Menschenmenge

back.example: I lost you in the crowd.

note: With the hint added, this card and the "amount" card stay clearly apart, because only this one is about people.
